traceability.notes:
docs/stories/009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS.story.md is a concrete spec for maintenance tools (detect/update/batch/verify/report/safe behavior). The story file content matches the assessed specification, and a dedicated test set exists that references this story and its REQ-MAINT-* requirement IDs directly. Re-running those targeted maintenance and performance tests shows 10/10 suites and 38/38 tests passing, confirming functional, performance, and error-handling aspects.
The maintenance tools are exposed both as a programmatic API (via a validated index export) and as a CLI (traceability-maint bin), satisfying integration requirements. CLI tests demonstrate clear user feedback, JSON/human-readable output, appropriate exit codes, and robust handling of invalid inputs, missing directories, and permission failures. Update and batch operations are tested on fixture files and large workspaces, showing correct, non-destructive updates and acceptable performance. README and user-docs provide explicit Maintenance CLI/API documentation. Together, this concrete evidence demonstrates that all listed requirements and acceptance criteria for Story 009.0-DEV-MAINTENANCE-TOOLS are implemented and currently passing, so the story is fully satisfied.
